🤖 AI + PMM News This Month

The Agentic Era Has Arrived

2026 is officially the year of agentic AI in marketing. Static workflows are being replaced by agent copilots across HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, and Make.com.

What This Means for PMMs

  • 📋 Positioning must be machine-readable — structured data beats prose
  • 🔄 Messaging frameworks need to feed AI agents directly
  • ⚡ Competitive intel becomes real-time, not quarterly
  • 🎯 Campaigns adjust mid-flight without human intervention

The Academy is updating content to reflect this shift. PMMs who understand agentic systems will lead.
